commitResults.messageTitle: Filled in [to be filled] in AGENTS.md file
Change from Duke to Edith chatbot with corresponding ASCII Art
Update the initial code to simply greet the user and exit.
Echo User Command and Exit on bye
Add the ability to store tasks, and display them on list command
Implement the mark command to update task status, without using additional classes
Implement the unmark command to update task status, without using additional classes
Implement markAsDone and markAsNotDone as methods under Task class. Maintain same functionality as before.
Added /present-changes-visually skill, which to compare most 2 recent commits.

- Made Task class abstract - Added Todo, Deadline, Event classes which inherit Task - Added command substrings in Edith.java to handle new commands - Added addTask(), addDeadline() and addEvent() to handle new commands and behaviour
Created test-ui skill and automate changes after every edit

Added Error Handling (Edith Exception) for incorrect user inputs: - inapplicable command - no task description (todo, deadline, event) - no deadline due time - no event parameters (description, /from, /end) - no event arguments (start time, end time) - no task number for mark/unmark - out of range task number for mark/unmark
- Added Delete functionality - Changed Task Array to ArrayList - removed all taskCount instances - Ensure tests cover correct renumbering of tasks after deletion
Use Java enum for CommandType to case switch between different commands.
Save task list on hard drive
commitResults.messageBody: Save the tasks on edith.txt file in ./data. Opens new file upon first task command if data file doesn't exist at the start. Also handles the case where the folder doesn't exist yet. Continuously updates edith.txt during each user command
